results.action: Open index.html
results.expected: Welcome heading is visible and focused; Open folder action is present

results.action: Click Open folder as workspace
results.expected: Picker screen with both folders; hash #picker; heading focused

results.action: Cancel the picker
results.expected: Back at Welcome, status says nothing changed

results.action: Pick Empty notes
results.expected: Workspace empty state with Create your first note

results.action: Create first note: default name, invalid name, then correction
results.expected: Dialog opens with "Untitled" selected; "a/b" shows an error and disables Create; "Plan A" creates and opens a tab

results.action: Close workspace, reopen the same folder
results.expected: Welcome shown; reopened folder lists Plan A; no tab restored

results.action: Close workspace, open Basalt notes, open Weekly plan, Meeting notes, Weekly plan again
results.expected: List shows 3 notes; two tabs; reopening focuses existing tab, no duplicate

results.action: Switch tabs by clicking a tab
results.expected: Clicked tab becomes current and editor shows its text

results.action: New note: case-only collision "weekly plan", then default "Untitled"
results.expected: Collision rejected inline with Create disabled; Untitled opens as third tab

results.action: Second new note offers "Untitled 1"
results.expected: Default name avoids the existing Untitled

results.action: Type in Untitled and wait for autosave
results.expected: Not saved + dot, then Saving…, then Saved

results.action: Close a clean active tab
results.expected: Tab closes, neighbour becomes active, status announces it

results.action: Type then immediately close the tab (unsaved text, save works)
results.expected: Tab closes without a dialog; reopening shows the typed text

results.action: Select "saves fail", type, wait
results.expected: Banner (alert) with Retry; state Not saved; text kept; autosave paused

results.action: Close the tab while save fails; Retry; Cancel
results.expected: Save-failed dialog names the note; Retry fails with a message; Cancel keeps the tab and text; focus returns

results.action: Open the dialog again and press Escape
results.expected: Escape means Cancel: dialog closes, nothing discarded

results.action: Switch to "fails once", close tab, Retry in dialog
results.expected: Retry succeeds, dialog closes, tab closes; reopening shows the saved text

results.action: Saves fail, edit, close tab, Discard changes
results.expected: Discard reverts to last saved text and closes the tab

results.action: Close workspace while a note has unsaved text and saves fail
results.expected: Dialog blocks closing; Cancel keeps workspace; Discard changes then closes it

results.action: Browser Back from the open workspace
results.expected: App stays on the workspace and says how to leave

results.action: Close workspace, then Browser Back and Forward
results.expected: Back lands on a valid screen (Welcome) with explanation; Forward does not reopen a workspace

results.action: Go to an unknown fragment
results.expected: Recovery screen with a Go to Welcome link

results.action: Reset after creating notes and changing the Test state
results.expected: Welcome; created note gone; Test state back to succeeds; no dialog; status announces

results.action: Reset while the Save-failed dialog is open
results.expected: Dialog closes and the prototype returns to Welcome

results.action: Keyboard only: open folder, pick folder, open note, tab to its close button
results.expected: Enter/Space activate controls; focus is always visible; dialog traps Tab and Escape returns focus

results.action: Narrow viewport 375x800 on the workspace
results.expected: No horizontal page scroll; New note, Close workspace and editor reachable

results.action: Inspect all requests made during the walk
results.expected: Only the file:// page itself was requested
